text:
nina: Quick heads-up: some tenant dashboards are showing 0% sampling after yesterday's quota backpressure spike. Root cause looks like SDKs treating missing sampling header as explicit 0.
rafael: Which header exactly? We recently changed the sampler to prefer mode tags when under heavy load.
nina: The backend occasionally emits no x-sample-rate (it omits the numeric header) and we started sending x-sample-tag: aggressive for those tenants. But older SDKs read absence of x-sample-rate as 0.
emily: Ok, two pivots: 1) make backend emit x-sample-tag (safe) and 2) push SDKs to treat missing numeric header as "use local fallback".
zack: SDK owners: nina you own TS, rafael you own Go, emily take Python?
nina: I can do TS. Plan: Parse numeric if present and >0, else map tags to rates via config. I'll add a feature flag to keep behavior backward-compatible.
rafael: Go will mirror that. I'll add a small integration test in our e2e harness to assert that missing x-sample-rate doesn't zero out metrics.
emily: Python patch idea: add SampleResolver that looks like: ```python
class SampleResolver:
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        self.cfg = cfg
    def resolve(self, headers):
        rate = headers.get('x-sample-rate')
        if rate:
            try:
                r = float(rate)
                if r > 0: return r
            except ValueError: pass
        tag = headers.get('x-sample-tag')
        return self.cfg.tag_to_rate.get(tag, self.cfg.default_rate)
```
nina: TS equivalent: ```ts
function resolveSample(h: Record<string,string>, cfg: Config){
  const raw = h['x-sample-rate'];
  if (raw){ const n = Number(raw); if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n>0) return n; }
  const tag = h['x-sample-tag'];
  return cfg.tagMap[tag] ?? cfg.defaultRate;
}
```
rafael: Go sketch: read header with http.Header.Get, parse float via strconv.ParseFloat, fallback to map. I'll open the PR this afternoon.
emily: We should also update the Console to show "sampling mode" next to numeric value so Product can interpret zeros vs short-circuits. Can we surface tag-to-rate mapping in a tooltip?
zack: Yes, Console work: add a small badge: Mode: aggressive | steady | bypass, and hover text with effective rate. I'll add a quick UI card for the release playbook.
ops-bot: Note: backend DB migration for sampled_mode index planned for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC if we want historical mode queries.
rafael: I'd prefer to avoid migration for initial rollout. Emit x-sample-tag as optional header only and keep existing storage unchanged.
nina: Rollout proposal: opt-in SDK parsing behind env var for all three clients -> enable backend emission for 5% tenant sample -> 24h watch -> 25% -> 72h observe -> global.
zemily: (typo) I mean emily: Also add an eval harness run comparing the sample distribution and a small quality metric (completion coherence) for canary vs control. We don't want sampling semantics to bias evals.
emily: I'll add the eval and a short note in the release notes: "SDKs will honor x-sample-tag when x-sample-rate is absent or zero; upgrade recommended to avoid 0% dashboard artifacts."
zack: Please avoid phrasing as "breaking"; call it "behavioral adjustment" and include migration steps. Product agreed.
rafael: CI checklist: unit tests for header parsing, integration test in e2e harness, changelog entry, and a smoke test for Console badge rendering.
nina: Timeline: ship opt-in SDK PRs today, backend opt-in for 5% tomorrow morning, monitor 48h, then expand. I'll coordinate canary tenants list with infra and expose an admin endpoint so Console can display who is in the canary.
ops-bot: Created ticket PLAT-8293 "sampling-tag header rollout" and assigned to nina, rafael, emily, zack. Reminder: tag your PRs with `sampling-rollout` label for tracking.
